{{- /* One footer link, a port of the shared theme's `absolute-link` define. The feed gives paths as root-relative ("/pricing/") because it is authored for www.gooddata.ai, while these docs are served from a sub-path of that host in production and from localhost in development — so a bare href would resolve against the docs, not the marketing site. `aria-label` and `rel` are emitted only when passed, as production does: the social buttons carry both (their content is an SVG, so the label is their accessible name) and nothing else does. target="_blank" implies noopener in current browsers anyway. Expects: item ({title, link}), class, idPrefix; optional icon (raw SVG), ariaLabel, rel. */ -}} {{- $item := .item -}} {{- with $item.link -}} {{- $href := cond (hasPrefix . "http") . (printf "https://www.gooddata.ai%s" .) -}} {{- $id := printf "%s%s" $.idPrefix (replace (lower $item.title) " " "-") -}} {{ with $.icon }}{{ . | safeHTML }}{{ else }}{{ $item.title }}{{ end }} {{- end -}}
